component.name: NightManager
component.summary: Switch to night mode on a schedule

description.p: NightManager keeps a phone from disturbing your sleep. At the evening time it switches to the night settings you choose, and in the morning it puts your day settings back.

ul.li: Night Light, automatic brightness, dark style, accent color, GTK3 theme and icon theme
Per-day start and end times, or Night Light's own schedule
Start or end night mode early from the quick settings

description.p: First Flatpak release, replacing the script-based version.
